## Checklist

- [ ] A new feature lives in its own folder under `features/` with its own on/off setting
- [ ] Tested with dark mode ON and OFF
- [ ] With the feature off, the page looks exactly like stock ServiceTitan
- [ ] No network requests, remote code, `eval` or new permissions
- [ ] Doesn't read, store or send customer, job or invoice data
- [ ] No console errors, including on pages the feature doesn't apply to
- [ ] Didn't change `version` in `manifest.json`
